title: Enhancement Vanilla
description: Client vanilla+ modpack completely improves the experience of playing Minecraft both in single player mode and on servers!
body:
**I made this modpack for a looong time and I want you to try an improved experience of playing Minecraft, while all mods are client-side and with a customized config. I also made a _**resource pack**_ with a **custom** menu specifically for this modpack, so I just want you to appreciate my efforts and play it, and if you like it, you can recommend the modpack to your friends and in the future I will update it and transfer it to other versions!**
### This modpack contains:
- Сustom resource pack
- 30+ Optimization mods
- Customized mod configs
- Beautiful visual
- Improved sound effects
- **and...**
# Unique gameplay features
### LEGS!!! 
**It fits perfectly into Vanilla and looks very fresh, and does not interfere with movement like the First-person Model.** (the mod that does this has 200 downloads lol)
![Legs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5bcd0030c9889d6b84f5599df26b9f22a3e65985.png)

___
### Astronomy
****A completely new mechanic!** Now you can explore stars and planets, draw constellations and rename them with the help of a spyglass. There are 3 modes of the spyglass:**
1. **Normal** (you can zoom in with the mouse wheel)
2. **Purple** (you can draw and rename constellations)
3. **Green** (you can rename stars and planets)

![Stars](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/73f8f2462a9d560c9a5181125cd5b62044723167.gif)

___
### Chiseled Bookshelf Preview
**With this modpack it becomes convenient to store books in a bookshelf, when you hover over a book it shows what kind of book it is, so create **huge** libraries instead of the _usual_ chests!**
![Books](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/458fe0942d85db2cdca169258098cc231d541ea5.png)

___
### Useful compass
**Now the coordinates are shown at the bottom of the compass and a minimalistic compass HUD at the top, so you don't have to open F3 but use the compass, which is more varied and vanilla.** (Coordinates removed from F3, you can enable them in config)
![Compass](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06ae09b4d2deb7c0bd343cb441cc22b43b0c31c4.jpeg)
___
### Other information:
- **Shader:** Complementary Shaders - Reimagined _r5.5.1._
- **GUI Resourcepack:** Shrimp's Immersive Interfaces _0.7.2_
- **Total mods:** 97
